description: This file contains test utility functions for creating and managing test data such as users, blocks, cards, and boards in the focalboard project. It also includes helper functions for extracting IDs from various model types during testing.

methods.name: createTestUsers
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test users with unique IDs, usernames, and emails.

methods.name: createTestBlocks
methods.description: Creates a specified number of test blocks associated with a user.

methods.name: createTestBlocksForCard
methods.description: Creates text blocks as children of a specified card.

methods.name: createTestCards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of card blocks within a board.

methods.name: createTestBoards
methods.description: Creates a specified number of boards within a team.

methods.name: deleteTestBoard
methods.description: Deletes a test board by ID.

methods.name: extractIDs
methods.description: Extracts and sorts IDs from various model slices for comparison in tests.
